name: Duct cleaning
summary: Cleaning of supply and return ducts, grilles and diffusers for better air quality.
description: Over time, ducts collect dust, debris and microbial growth that blow straight into the space and reduce airflow. We inspect the ductwork, clean it with brushes and vacuum equipment, and clean the grilles, diffusers and plenum boxes, so the air your system delivers is cleaner and stronger.
duration: Half a day to several days, depending on duct length
suitable_for: Ductable, package, VRF ducted, AHU and central systems
includes: Inspection of supply and return ducts
Mechanical brushing and HEPA vacuum extraction
Grille, diffuser and plenum box cleaning
signs: Dust blowing out of the grilles
Musty smell from the ducted system
Ducts haven't been cleaned in 2+ years

process.title: Inspection
process.text: We check duct condition and access points.

process.title: Cleaning
process.text: Brushing and vacuum extraction section by section.

process.title: Grilles & diffusers
process.text: Every outlet is removed, washed and refitted.

faqs.question: How often should ducts be cleaned?
faqs.answer: Every 2 – 3 years for offices and homes, and more often for hospitals, kitchens and dusty sites.

faqs.question: Will it disturb our work?
faqs.answer: We work zone by zone and can schedule cleaning after hours or on weekends.
